clips.title: Front kick
clips.summary: 4 key moments: ready -> right foot up, right foot forward -> right foot down, right foot back -> right foot up, right foot forward -> right foot down, right foot back -> finish

clips.title: Squat jump
clips.summary: 7 key moments, 2 jumps: ready -> crouch -> rise, right hand back -> jump -> land -> crouch, right hand forward -> rise, right hand back -> crouch, left hand forward -> rise, left hand back -> jump -> land -> left hand forward, right hand up (finish)

clips.title: Jumping jacks
clips.summary: 10 key moments: ready -> right hand up, left hand up -> right hand down, left hand down -> right hand up, left hand up -> right hand down, left hand down -> right hand up, left hand up -> right hand down, left hand down -> right hand up, left hand up -> right hand down, left hand down -> right hand up, left hand up -> right hand down, left hand down (finish)

clips.title: Lunge
clips.summary: 13 key moments: ready -> crouch, right foot left -> right foot forward, right foot right -> crouch -> rise -> right foot back, rise -> left foot up -> left foot down, left foot forward -> crouch -> rise, step back -> right foot forward, left foot back -> crouch -> rise, left foot forward -> right hand down, right foot right (finish)

clips.title: Punches
clips.summary: 11 key moments: ready -> right hand up -> left hand up -> left hand forward -> right hand forward, left hand back -> right hand back, left hand forward -> right hand forward, left hand back -> right hand back, left hand forward -> right hand forward, left hand back -> right hand back, left hand forward -> right hand forward, left hand back -> right hand back, right hand down (finish)
